title: I Let the Vet-Boarding Camera Catch the Tech Who Unplugged the Kennel

parts.text: I dropped Miso at 7:55 a.m. and tech Lila unplugged kennel cam 2 "for a nap." The board said: CAMERAS STAY LIVE. LOG WALKS. NO UNPLUGS. I was thirty-eight, client, holding a boarding contract. Lila shrugged. "Techs are the ward." I photographed the board, the dark feed, and the plug in her hand. Then I asked for the kennel log. At 8:02 the vet pinged why Lila's name was on a dark cam. I did not argue the joke. I argued the file. A paper policy is only paper until someone treats it like a clock.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The vet can see kennel cam 2 dark with Lila's unplug on the log.

social.video_title: The tech unplugged the kennel camera for a nap — Part 1/2
social.description: Vet boarding, a live-cam board, a plug in her hand. I logged the dark feed. Would you have asked the vet?

parts.text: Lila called it kindness until the vet asked for the still. I printed the log, the board, and the photo. The cam went live. Lila logged walks and told the next tech kindness was always about optics. Optics is a word techs use when a contract exists. Camera policy now has a second line: TECHS DO NOT UNPLUG. I keep Miso's feed. Lila brown-bags the jokes. The ward finally looks like a contract, not a nap. If it is written, it can be applied to the person who wrote it.

social.description: Kennel log, live feed, and a second line. Was kindness ever a dark cam?
